author: Nintendo of America
description:
The show never stops in WWE 2K26, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in March 2026! Pre-order now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/wwe-2k26-standard-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01    

WWE 2K26 drops with the largest roster in franchise history, featuring over 400 WWE Superstars and Legends from every era, including The Rock, John Cena, Rhea Ripley, and more!

Relive or rewrite history and iconic moments from CM Punk's rebellious career. Bring the chaos with new match types like I Quit, Inferno, and Dumpster matches, plus the WWE Draft comes to Universe mode!
 
Control every outcome in Universe, build your dream squad in MyFACTION, and define your comeback story in MyRISE.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Scott Pilgrim EX is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on March 3, 2026!

Join Scott, Ramona, and an ensemble of former foes in this all-new time-bending, co-op brawler set in a chaotic Toronto. Fight gangs of demons, robots, and vegans in a city-spanning adventure packed with challenges and secrets. Master each fighter’s unique style, unlock upgrades, and wield wacky weapons in single-player or 4-player co-op (online or local). Featuring a brand-new story by Bryan Lee O'Malley and an explosive soundtrack by Anamanaguchi!
